svg.text: A year ago, the Ashes came to Perth.
Australia played England in the first
Test at Perth Stadium — the first
Ashes Test at the ground. Australia
won in two days, by eight wickets. It
was the shortest Ashes Test, by balls
won the first three Tests — in Perth, in
Brisbane and in Adelaide — and kept
the Ashes after the third Test.
England won the fourth Test, in
Melbourne, by four wickets: their first
Test win in Australia for almost
fifteen years. Australia won the fifth
Test, in Sydney, by five wickets. The
Cummins, was out with a back injury,
and the fast bowler Josh Hazlewood
was out with a hamstring injury. Steve
Smith led the side instead. Scott
Boland played, and the young fast
England's team was more settled. Ben
Stokes was the captain. Joe Root, the
batter England needed most, was in
the team, with Jofra Archer and Mark
Wood to bowl fast. England had not
won a Test series in Australia since
The last series, in England in 2023,
One Test lasts up to five days — but
two Tests in this series lasted only
two. The first Test in Perth ended in
two days, and so did the fourth Test in
